summary.zh: 按语言规则评审代码并给出合并结论
summary.en: Review diffs in 14 languages and return a merge verdict

description.zh: 对 PR、diff、单个函数或整份文件做评审，按语言检查安全、异步与资源释放、错误处理和性能问题，给出阻断项、非阻断项与合并结论。覆盖 TypeScript、Python、Go、Rust、Java 等主流语言。
description.en: Reviews pull requests, diffs or a single function with per-language rules for security, async and resource handling, error handling and performance. Returns blocking and non-blocking findings plus a merge verdict.
